name: Crop Image
description: Crop an image to specified dimensions

fields.name: image_url
fields.description: Upload an image to crop — Use public HTTPS URLs only. If the harness gives a local path like /mnt/user-data/uploads/... or file://..., call upload_file first and use the returned permanent URL.

fields.name: x_percent
fields.description: Horizontal crop start position (percentage from left)

fields.name: y_percent
fields.description: Vertical crop start position (percentage from top)

fields.name: width_percent
fields.description: Crop width as a percentage of the original image

fields.name: height_percent
fields.description: Crop height as a percentage of the original image

fields.name: width_px
fields.description: Exact crop width in pixels. When width and height are set without X/Y, the crop is centered.

fields.name: height_px
fields.description: Exact crop height in pixels. When width and height are set without X/Y, the crop is centered.

fields.name: x_px
fields.description: Optional exact crop start position from the left. Leave empty to center pixel crops.

fields.name: y_px
fields.description: Optional exact crop start position from the top. Leave empty to center pixel crops.
